parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the instance status list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for the paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the elasticity assurance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
